proofs.text: Run the update on the v0.9.5 fixture answering every question `n`; verify the output contains `skipped config` and the pending ids are exactly what they were; then answer `n` to the records question alone and verify the pending ids afterwards are exactly `['records']`

rule_text: Every migration asks before it writes; a declined one is reported as skipped and left pending, and declining one never stops the others

tests.body:
def test_a_declined_migration_is_left_pending(tmp_path, capsys, monkeypatch):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    before = _ids(root)
    _answers(monkeypatch, default='n')
    assert _apply(root, argv=()) == 0
    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert 'skipped config' in printed
    assert _ids(root) == before
tests.name: test_a_declined_migration_is_left_pending
reasons: expected value computed by same function as SUT
